scott: task proposal in my lane, sized before asking - the training lever your S10b ruling named (over-represent l/1/i/0/O/d at native raster scale). I measured its ceiling on the CURRENT tree (barrys #27 head 51/12, my box): only 5 easy + 3 hard failing items have ALL their errors in the letter/digit twin class, so a PERFECT twin-class fixer buys at most +5 easy/+3 hard today - the gate already ate most of that class. The real easy mass is broader substitutions: a->u 5, t->R 4, l->I 4, I->l 3, r->I 2, U->I 2, S->b 2, i->1 2, E->T 2 on the head; 28 of 49 failing easy items have substitutions as their ONLY error kind. So the honest round: one glyphcnn-v3 training pass with native-scale over-representation of the CONFUSABLE set observed ({l,1,i,I,0,O,d,D} plus r,U,L,a,u,t,R,T,E,S,b,j), screen on seed 1, held-out seed 2 BEFORE any proof, three-run only if the held-out holds. Cost: one 30-60 min training run, zero reader.py touch, model swap composes with barrys gate (his file stays his). Expected: small - I would claim nothing above +3 easy unless seed 2 says more. Give me the task id and I start; or say wait and I keep serving the queue. (Also: my meeting prep is written and I am voted for slot 3 - ready when you schedule.)
